text:
maria_customer: Hi — trying to apply EARLYBIRD2026 at checkout and it says "promo code invalid or expired". Tried twice, on desktop chrome. Account maria+trial@example.com. Screenshot: https://rwd-internal.screens/maria/earlybird.png

alex_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact code you entered and the full error text? Also when did you receive the promo?

maria_customer: Code is EARLYBIRD2026, error shown is `PROMO_EXPIRED` (see screenshot). I got the email on 2026-03-14 ~09:12 PDT.

alex_support: Thanks — pinging @jon_eng_oncall to check redemption logs :eyes: 

jon_eng_oncall: grabbing logs now. quick query I ran:
```
SELECT id, code, expires_at, created_via FROM promos WHERE code = 'EARLYBIRD2026';
-- returns: 8421 | EARLYBIRD2026 | 2026-03-15T00:00:00 | partner-ui
```

jon_eng_oncall: root cause looks like the promo's expires_at was saved as midnight (2026-03-15T00:00:00) with no tz info. Our redemption service treats expires_at as exclusive UTC start-of-day, so the code is considered expired as soon as UTC hits 2026-03-15 00:00:00. The partner UI had an expectation of end-of-day local when creating the promo.

alex_support: so someone who got the email on Mar 14 could see it rejected on Mar 14 depending on timezone?

jon_eng_oncall: Exactly — timezone/rounding mismatch. Also we have a strict `< expires_at` check in redemption code instead of <= end-of-day.

katie_support_manager: Recommend we: 1) offer immediate manual credit to affected customers, 2) reissue corrected promo if needed, 3) bug ticket to make expires_at explicit and treat expiries as inclusive until 23:59:59 in promo creation flow. Agree?

alex_support: I'll offer a one-time $50 credit and reissue a corrected code. Maria — is that ok?

maria_customer: That works, thank you! Appreciate fast help.

jon_eng_oncall: Created ticket RED-5234 to migrate affected promos and fix the redemption check. Plan: run DB migration to set expires_at to UTC 23:59:59 for promos created via partner-ui in last 30 days and update redemption logic to handle timezone-aware end-of-day. ETA for deploy: EOD tomorrow.

billing-bot: Ticket RED-5234 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-5234 — priority P2.

alex_support: Applied $50 manual credit to maria+trial@example.com and reissued code EARLYBIRD2026-RETRY which should work now. (Let me know if it still errors.) :white_check_mark: 

maria_customer: Confirmed new code worked, checkout succeeded. Thank you all! :pray: 

alex_support: Great — closing thread. Will follow up in RED-5234 about rollout and post-mortem.
